(Bukhari 5681) In this sense, bearing an elegant and well-presented name like Zuhniyyah would be a living embodiment of the Prophet's instruction to take pride in one's appearance as part of practicing good hygiene and overall respect for self and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Zuhniyyah encapsulates the essence of adorning oneself with good character and inner beauty. The Prophet Muhammad once said, "Allah is beautiful and loves beauty." (Tirmidhi 2305) This name serves as a constant reminder to the namesake to endeavor towards cultivating their inner selves, focusing on essence over mere appearance, and to strive for beautiful deeds and pleasing manners that might bring them closer to Allah.
